select.foreach: (select a.*, b.id as extendInfoId, b.ledger_id, b.receive_user_type, b.purchasing_date, b.efficiency, b.plate_number, b.insurance from risk_source_ledger a left join risk_source_ledger_extend_info b on a.id = b.ledger_id where a.lat_and_lon IS NOT NULL AND a.lat_and_lon != '' and a.type_code = #{key} limit #{item.value})
